title: AggreProt-guided mutations improve LinB solubility and yield
summary: AggreProt is a deep neural-network predictor of residue-level protein aggregation propensity. Researchers used its predicted aggregation-prone regions to guide mutations in haloalkane dehalogenase LinB and report reduced aggregation, improved soluble yield and up to a 100% increase in yield over wild type under their assay. This is one engineered-enzyme result; model validation on selected peptides/proteins is ancillary, and the result does not establish industrial biodegradation performance.

evidence.tested: The paper reports the specific in-vitro protein assay summarized here.
evidence.unknown: Clinical or diagnostic deployment and independent replication are not established.
evidence.ai_role: The model identifies residue-level aggregation regions; predictions inform mutations that are experimentally assessed for aggregation, solubility and yield.

source_review.scope: Primary paper indexed full text and publication metadata reviewed.
